call_points.text: Wires & Cables segment delivered strong revenue growth supported by volume growth and higher realizations.
H1 FY27 operating EBITDA and PAT grew by 79% YoY and 87% YoY respectively.
FY27 volume growth expected at around 18%, same as guided at the start of FY26
Targets 100 bps year-on-year margin improvement and says it is confident of achieving it
New wire capacity at Silvassa expected this quarter; cable capacity at Waghodia during the year
Data centre is still at announcement stage; orders are few and its share of revenue is very small
Industry Wires & Cables growth assessed at 10-12% for the quarter, below the company's own pace
Margin gain attributed to scale and cost absorption, with no inventory gain or loss in the quarter
Metal prices up about 40% YoY, expected to reflect as about 25% in product pricing
Middle East disruption offset by other export markets; shipments normalised in May and June but supply-chain issues remain
US is a large opportunity but tariff clarity is pending; only a few approvals so far
FMEG targets about 20% annual growth and sustainable yearly breakeven this year, profitability in 2-3 years
Wires & cables segment profit margin rose 143 bps for the year

timeline.summary: R R Kabel Limited’s Senior Management, led by Anup Vaibhav C. Khanna, schedules earnings conference call on **30 April 2026 at 4:30 PM IST** for Q4 & FY2026 results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,964.14 Cr (+33.6% YoY), net profit ₹167.95 Cr.
R R Kabel Limited scheduled a virtual analyst/investor meet with Centrum - Nakshatra III Conference on 20 May 2026, led by C KHANNA and Anup Vaibhav C. Khanna.
Mahendrakumar Rameshwarlal Kabra, as Promoter, declared no encumbrance on R R Kabel Limited’s equity shares for FY2026 on 2 April 2026.

On its 27 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, R R Kabel reported highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹3,168 Cr (up 54% YoY), EBITDA of ₹285 Cr and PAT of ₹205 Cr, with FMEG reaching operational breakeven and FY28 Wires & Cables margin guidance held at 10.5%.
R R Kabel Limited scheduled an earnings conference call for quarter and six months ended 30 September 2026 on Thursday 29 October 2026 at 01:00 p.m. IST.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,284 Cr (+51.8% YoY), net profit ₹180.6 Cr (+55.3% YoY).
On October 28, 2026, RR Kabel reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹3,284 Cr and net profit of ₹180.6 Cr.
R R Kabel completed the acquisition of the business undertaking of U M Cables Limited via slump sale on October 31, 2026.
